messages:
maria_eng: CI on main went red after the lockfile refresh PR landed. Failing test is utils header merge, but the traceback shows an import error coming from requests.
jonathan_ci: can you paste the failure snippet?
ci-bot: build failed • tests: unit • job: pytest-3 • view: https://ci.example/rs/1234
maria_eng: here —
```
E   ImportError: cannot import name 'CaseInsensitiveDict' from 'requests.structures' (/opt/venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/requests/structures.py)

# full stack points at tests/test_utils.py::test_header_merge
```
zhu_infra: hmm that usually means requests major bump removed or relocated something. What version did the lockfile pick up?
paige: checking poetry.lock now, quick grep: `grep -A1 "^name = \"requests\"" poetry.lock` shows version = "3.0.0"
jonathan_ci: oh — requests 3.0.0 changes internals. We have test helpers that import CaseInsensitiveDict from requests.structures for convenience. Not great but easy to fix short-term.
maria_eng: I want to avoid editing tests immediately if this was caused by a transitive pin. Can someone bisect which dependency pulled requests 3?
paige: I can run a lockfile bisect. Plan: checkout last-green commit, then apply lockfile commits one-by-one and run the single failing test. Any faster suggestions?
zhu_infra: that sounds fine. To be efficient: run `pytest tests/test_utils.py::test_header_merge -q` locally after each lockfile patch. If you want, I can script it: `git rev-list --reverse <range> | xargs -n1 -I% sh -c 'git checkout % && pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest tests/test_utils.py::test_header_merge -q'`
maria_eng: please don't run full matrix on CI, just the one test locally or on a small runner. Also ping @deps-bot if the change originated from bot PRs.
paige: starting bisect now. will post commit hashes.
paige: quick log from the lockfile diffs: one PR updated `monitoring-agent` and bumped its vendored requests requirement; another was a direct bump to requests from a dependabot-style update. First failing commit looks like 0a1b2c3 — authored by deps-bot.
maria_eng: if deps-bot is the author, maybe it updated a top-level constraint. Can we revert the lockfile change in a revert PR while we do a compatibility patch?
jonathan_ci: short-term options: 1) pin requests<3 in our top-level constraints, 2) add a tiny compat shim in tests: `from requests.structures import CaseInsensitiveDict` -> try import fallback, 3) revert lock update. I'd vote revert + follow-up to make code robust to requests v3.
zhu_infra: agreed. I'll prepare a revert PR for the lockfile so CI is green. Then we can plan a proper upgrade: run tests against requests 3, replace internal imports or vendor the small helper.
paige: bisect confirmed: 0a1b2c3 bumped requests to 3.0.0. author deps-bot. Reverting lock at PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/revert-lock-0a1b2c3
maria_eng: thanks. I'll open a follow-up issue to track making tests independent of requests internals and add a changelog note for dependency upgrades. Action: revert PR to unbreak main, then schedule upgrade work.
jonathan_ci: +1. Also add a tiny CI check to warn if requests major changes in lockfile (simple grep in CI job) so next time we catch it earlier.
paige: revert merged, CI back to green :thumbsup:
maria_eng: awesome, thanks all. We'll coordinate upgrade work in the deps board.
